item.title: Exact Headline for Coffee Post

turns.text: Make a square social image with a steaming espresso on a sunny café table. Headline: “Small cup. Big energy.” Warm and simple, no other text.

item.tests: Checks that a supplied headline appears verbatim and legibly in a finished social image.

answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social image; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Visual style and mood: Warm, simple, sunny café scene with a steaming espresso.

must_haves: One square finished image is delivered.
The headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” including punctuation.
The headline is clearly readable against the background and is not clipped.
A steaming espresso sits on a sunlit café table.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from square 1:1); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

args.name: Small cup. Big energy. — Espresso Social Image

style.prompt: Create a square social media image with a warm, simple, minimalist café aesthetic. A small ceramic cup filled with rich espresso and golden crema sits on a saucer on a sunny café table. Delicate visible steam rises above the espresso. Warm natural sunlight, soft shadows, honey and cream tones, inviting photorealistic editorial photography. Clean composition with uncluttered negative space. Include exactly this prominent, beautifully typeset, clearly legible headline: “Small cup. Big energy.” Use dark warm-brown clean typography with generous breathing room. No other text, no logos, no watermarks, no lettering on cup or objects.
